newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks end lower, weighed by weaker oils.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks end lower, weighed by weaker oils.

text.p: * Toronto stocks closed lower, pressured by falling oils and conglomerates. * Strong banks, consumer products kept losses in check. * 94 million shares traded worth C$1.4 billion.
Toronto's stock market drifted lower in moderate trading to close softer on Monday, weighed down by a battered oil and gas sector.
The key 300 Composite Index fell 20.47 points to end at 6081.27 in trading of 93.9 million shares worth C$1.4 billion.
"The energy sector's the one that got clipped here," said fund manager Josef Schachter. But he forecast the weakness was only short term. "This is just a buying opportunity."
The oil and gas group lost almost 2.4 percent and led eight of Toronto's 14 sub-indices south.
